method: Independent 5-degree phase estimation on each locked source using grayscale polar angular finite-difference response; outer radial windows only. SRC-0003 was not seeded with SRC-0002 observed offsets.

classificationRule.CONFIRMED: abs phase-normalized delta <= 1.0deg and both source response percentiles >= 75
classificationRule.PARTIAL: abs delta <= 1.5deg and both response percentiles >= 50

interpretation.reason: Independent SRC-0003 analysis recovers a 5-degree periodic family and 61/72 boundaries are CONFIRMED or PARTIAL under a predeclared uniform classification rule, but only 32/72 meet the stronger CONFIRMED condition and source-specific art/text can still influence local maxima.

next: Populate MF-288 continuity evidence using per-boundary support plus verified radial-band evidence; do not assign AK IDs.
